name: Declan O'Connell
bio:
Declan's journey into motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with engines on his family's farm in County Cork. This hands-on experience, coupled with a degree in mechanical engineering from University College Dublin, laid the foundation for his career. He started in Formula Ford, working his way up through various junior series before landing a role in Formula 1 with a smaller team. 

After several years gaining invaluable experience at the back of the grid, Declan was headhunted by Scuderia Ferrari. He brings a pragmatic and methodical approach to performance engineering, focusing on data-driven analysis and continuous improvement. While not a natural manager, his technical acumen and ability to identify subtle performance gains make him a valuable asset to the team, even if he prefers working independently. His dedication and sharp eye for detail are hallmarks of his work.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Declan is a man of medium build with a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of strong black coffee throughout the day.
